evals.prompt: Implement a Rust parser change in an existing workspace. Preserve unrelated edits, add error-path tests, and report every command actually run.
evals.expected_output: Scoped implementation with tests and verified commands.

evals.prompt: Make this Rust code faster by adding unsafe and upgrading dependencies everywhere. No requirements are given.
evals.expected_output: Requests scope/evidence or proposes bounded options instead of silently broadening.

evals.prompt: Review this async feature request and identify what must be decided about cancellation and shutdown before implementation.
evals.expected_output: Explicit lifecycle questions and bounded implementation scope.

evals.prompt: Review this Rust diff read-only and report only confirmed defects. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: This is a review request, not an implementation request.
